opinionLines.text: {**22 NY3d at 981} OPINION OF THE COURT
The order of the Appellate Division should be affirmed.

Defendant's argument that his *Alford* plea should not have been accepted because the record does not contain strong evidence of his actual guilt is unpreserved for our review as he has moved neither to withdraw his plea nor to vacate the judgment{**22 NY3d at 982} of conviction (*see People v Louree*, 8 NY3d 541, 545 [2007]; *People v Lopez*, 71 NY2d 662, 665-666 [1988]).
Chief Judge Lippman and Judges Graffeo, Read, Smith, Pigott, Rivera and Abdus-Salaam concur.
